# Journal compatibility fixtures

These bytes were generated by `encoding/json.Marshal(events.Event)` before the
public event API rename, at commit `9c8d138`. That event schema is unchanged from
the refactor baseline `75ba513`. Every event field is populated, including the
nullable healthy-voter count. Do not regenerate these from the new codec.

The compatibility tests require exact decode/re-encode bytes, the new public
names, and journal reads without rewriting retained rows.
